UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Authenticated user's Google profile metadata and preferences, isolated strictly to the owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown on the user's profile.

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL or compressed data URL for the user profile.

dailyGoal.description: Daily target number of episodes to read (1 to 50).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserReadingState.title: UserReadingState
UserReadingState.description: Authenticated user's subscribed series, liked episodes, and reading history.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

subscribedIds.description: Bounded list of subscribed series IDs (max 100).

likedEpisodeIds.description: Bounded list of liked episode IDs (max 200).

readEpisodeIds.description: Bounded list of read episode IDs (max 200).

dailyProgressDate.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD date string for today's reading progress.

dailyReadEpisodeIds.description: Bounded list of episode IDs read today (max 100).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when reading state was updated.

SiteConfig.title: SiteConfig
SiteConfig.description: Global site configuration, announcement banner, featured/hidden series overrides managed by site admins.

announcementEnabled.description: Whether the global top announcement banner is visible.

announcementTone.description: Visual tone of the announcement banner.

canvasSubmissionsEnabled.description: Whether public Canvas series submissions are open.

hiddenSeriesIds.description: Bounded list of series IDs hidden from public discovery (max 100).

featuredSeriesIds.description: Bounded list of series IDs pinned to the Hero Showcase (max 20).

updatedBy.description: Verified admin email that last updated the site configuration.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when site config was last updated.

SiteTeam.title: SiteTeam
SiteTeam.description: RBAC directory of verified Admin and Moderator Google email allowlists managed by admins.

adminEmails.description: Bounded list of verified Admin emails (max 25).

moderatorEmails.description: Bounded list of verified Moderator emails (max 50).

displayNames.description: Map of lowercase staff email to display name.

updatedBy.description: Verified admin email that last updated the team directory.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when team directory was last updated.

StaffRole.title: StaffRole
StaffRole.description: Individual staff role assignment for an Admin or Moderator account.

id.description: Document ID matching the staff role record.

email.description: Lowercase Google account email granted staff privileges.

displayName.description: Display name for the team member.

addedBy.description: Verified admin email who created or updated this role.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the role was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the role was last updated.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Immutable audit log entry recording actions taken by verified Admins and Moderators.

id.description: Document ID matching the activity log entry.

actorEmail.description: Verified Google email of the admin or moderator who performed the action.

actorName.description: Display name of the actor at the time of the action.

actorRole.description: Role held by the actor when performing the action.

category.description: Domain category of the audited action.

action.description: Specific operation performed by the actor.

targetId.description: Optional identifier of the affected series, episode, comment, or staff record.

targetLabel.description: Human-readable label of the affected target.

details.description: Optional concise summary of changes made.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the activity log entry was recorded.

SiteAds.title: SiteAds
SiteAds.description: Admin-managed sponsor advertising configuration and bounded active/scheduled campaigns.

adsEnabled.description: Master switch controlling whether sponsor ads render on the storefront and reader.

campaigns.description: Bounded list of sponsor ad campaigns (max 15).

adsterra.description: Optional Adsterra Publishers integration settings and bounded ad unit zones (max 10).

adskeeper.description: Optional AdsKeeper Dashboard integration settings and bounded widget units (max 10).

adsense.description: Optional Google AdSense publisher ID, Auto Ads switch, and bounded ad slot sizes/units (max 10).

updatedBy.description: Verified admin email that last updated sponsor campaigns.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when sponsor ads configuration was last updated.

/users/{userId}/private/info.description: Owner-only Google profile and preferences document.

/users/{userId}/private/readingState.description: Owner-only webtoon subscriptions, likes, and reading history.

/site/ads.description: Admin-managed sponsor ads and partner campaign directory.

/site/team.description: Admin-managed RBAC allowlist for Admins and Moderators.

/staffRoles/{staffId}.description: Individual staff role assignments readable by admins and the assigned user.

/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Append-only audit trail of admin and moderator operations.
